en.approve: Approve this draft and send in the stated window
en.ready: Draft ready for one content-and-send review.
en.meaning: Approve confirms this exact draft, recipients, materials and send window. It does not approve another version.
en.waiting: Waiting for your decision; no email has been sent.
en.receipt: Sending also records one operational CRM result Note when a real customer record exists; no new customer facts or persona changes are approved.

zh-CN.approve: 确认草稿并批准按上述窗口发送
zh-CN.ready: 草稿已准备，请一次审核内容并决定是否按所示窗口发送。
zh-CN.meaning: 批准将同时确认本版正文、收件人、资料和发送窗口；不批准其他版本。
zh-CN.placeholder: 如需修改，请在此填写具体意见。
zh-CN.waiting: 等待提交审核决定；尚未发送邮件。
zh-CN.receipt: 发送后可在已匹配的 CRM 客户下记录一条发送结果；本次不批准新的客户事实或画像变更。
